reasoning: Let Z(n) = sum_{i>=1} floor(n/5^i) be the number of trailing zeros of n!. Z is nondecreasing and increases only at multiples of 5: at n = 5m it jumps by 1 + v5(m), so a jump of size d skips d-1 values of k. Z(40010) = 8002+1600+320+64+12+2 = 10000, and Z takes a new value at each of the 8002 multiples of 5 from 5 to 40010, so exactly 8002 positive integers k <= 10000 are attained. Hence the unattained count is 10000 - 8002 = 1998. Cross-check via skipped values: sum_{m=1}^{8002} v5(m) = floor(8002/5)+floor(8002/25)+floor(8002/125)+floor(8002/625)+floor(8002/3125) = 1600+320+64+12+2 = 1998. Also verified by brute-force enumeration of Z(n) for n < 40100.
